name: A Rat's Tail
source:
An interactive visual novel that explores themes of classism and beauty standards through rats in the sewers. Follow Ratona as she tries to discover who stole the cheese!

[Edited from [url=https://madiimakesgames.itch.io/a-rats-tail]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部互动视觉小说，通过下水道里的老鼠探索古典主义和美丽标准的主题。跟随拉托娜，尝试找出是谁偷了奶酪！

[编辑自[url=https://madiimakesgames.itch.io/a-rats-tail]itch.io[/url]]
